---
title: "Identifying Influencer Agents in Swarms With Quantum Circuits"
date: 2021-05-01
categories: [quantum computing, swarm robotics]
description: "Using quantum circuits to explore influencer selection for flock control."
image: ../images/qcc.png
---

The goal was to use quantum computing ideas for hard combinatorial problems in collective robotics. Given a communication or influence network, the task is to split agents into leaders and followers so that a small set of influencers can guide the flock while satisfying constraints.
